summary: Blocking release gate extracted as `npm run release:verify` (tools/release-verify.cjs): the full `npm run ci` chain as 10 explicit steps where EVERY step blocks, visual regression blocks (unlike the ci.yml matrix job where it stays continue-on-error advisory), and the economy sim (test:sim:economy, absent from the GitHub matrix job) is included. Explicit retry policy: exactly 1 retry for the two Playwright steps (e2e, visual) against environment flake, 0 retries for deterministic steps; a pass on the 2nd attempt is recorded as flaky in the artifact (steps[].flaky + summary.flaky) instead of being hidden. No fail-fast: all steps run so the artifact is always complete. Preflight checks runtime pin consistency (js/storage.js SCHEMA_VERSION, index.html ?v= pins, sw.js nd-shell-vN) and refuses to start on desync. Complete artifact docs/release/verify/artifact.json records git HEAD/branch/dirty, env (node/npm/platform/CI), source-parsed versions, per-step commands, exit codes of every attempt, durations, and per-attempt log paths under docs/release/verify/logs/. A crash mid-run leaves artifact.json at result:'running' (stale artifacts never masquerade as fresh). GitHub workflow: new release-gate job (push to main only) runs the gate and uploads the artifact; deploy now needs [test, release-gate] — deploy only after the release gate. Verified by a real full gate run on this VPS: 10/10 steps PASS, exit 0, no flakes (e2e 196s, visual 146s, unit suite 597 tests incl. the 10 new gate-contract tests). No runtime code changed, so shell pins stay ?v=104/nd-shell-v104 (no repin required); AGENTS.md verification section updated to describe the gate.
limitations: No runtime changes in R3 (tools/tests/workflow/docs only), so index.html ?v= pins and sw.js nd-shell-v shell stay at 104 — no synchronized pin bump required this package; version consistency 104/104 + schema 14 is asserted by the gate preflight and recorded in docs/release/verify/artifact.json.

The modified GitHub Actions workflow was not executed on GitHub runners from this VPS (no push authorized): verified via a real local full gate run (npm run release:verify, 10/10 PASS) plus YAML parse of .github/workflows/ci.yml (jobs test/release-gate/deploy; deploy.needs=[test, release-gate]; release-gate gated to refs/heads/main). First real GitHub-side run happens on the driver's push.

On GitHub runners the release gate's visual step is expected to block deploys until CI-native visual baselines are captured (baselines are off-CI; the matrix job keeps visual advisory for PR feedback) — this is the intended blocking-release semantics, not a regression.
Retry policy is explicit but minimal: exactly 1 retry for the two Playwright steps; deterministic steps are never retried; flakes are recorded, not silenced.

The committed gate artifact truthfully records dirty=true / head=c5f147c because R3 files were uncommitted in the working tree at run time (driver commits after exit); re-running release:verify post-commit will record the committed SHA.
